parsed.title: Premium Insights Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock exclusive in-depth news analysis by playing a quick game.

newMechanic.name: Premium Insights
newMechanic.description: An additive tier of exclusive investigative deep-dive articles, marked with a distinctive 'Premium' badge. Access requires a new content-gating backend infrastructure that tracks individual 'PremiumAccess' entitlements per user.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To establish a value-exchange for high-quality journalism, creating a premium ad-supported tier without removing any existing free content.

parsed.trigger: Returning user (session 2+) taps an article in the feed tagged as 'Premium'.

offer.title: Unlock Premium Insight
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to access this in-depth investigative article.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Access is rate-limited to 3 premium articles per day via ad-unlocking. All existing free articles remain completely unblocked and ad-accessible as they are today; premium content is strictly additive.

kpis.holdout: 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks to monitor IAP conversion impact if subscriptions are introduced.

risks: Low ad fill rate in certain geographies.
Editorial dependency on producing high-value investigative content.
